panels.description: Latest PMU frequency readings mapped to five tracked OpenStreetMap demonstration locations: Neuenhagen, Marzahn, Koppenplatz, Lichterfelde, and Radeland. Marker colour and size represent frequency in Hz.

builder.query: SELECT CASE "mrid" WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-01:frequency' THEN 'Neuenhagen' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-02:frequency' THEN 'Marzahn' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-03:frequency' THEN 'Koppenplatz / Mitte' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-04:frequency' THEN 'Lichterfelde' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-05:frequency' THEN 'Radeland / Spandau' END AS site, CASE "mrid" WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-01:frequency' THEN CAST(52.5384117 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-02:frequency' THEN CAST(52.5356976 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-03:frequency' THEN CAST(52.5276066 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-04:frequency' THEN CAST(52.4238697 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-05:frequency' THEN CAST(52.5503022 AS DOUBLE) END AS latitude, CASE "mrid" WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-01:frequency' THEN CAST(13.7007858 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-02:frequency' THEN CAST(13.5240397 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-03:frequency' THEN CAST(13.3985493 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-04:frequency' THEN CAST(13.3100566 AS DOUBLE) WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-05:frequency' THEN CAST(13.1716294 AS DOUBLE) END AS longitude, LATEST_BY("double_value", "__time") AS frequency_hz, MAX("__time") AS observed_at FROM "live_measurements" WHERE "mrid" IN ('urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-01:frequency','urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-02:frequency','urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-03:frequency','urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-04:frequency','urn:wama:poc:pmu:bay-05:frequency') AND "__time" BETWEEN MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}) AND MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3

panels.description: Live Open-Meteo Berlin observations published by the managed weather processor. Marker colour and size reflect the queried weather value; the tooltip includes the metric and time.

builder.query: SELECT 'Berlin' AS site, CAST(52.5200 AS DOUBLE) AS latitude, CAST(13.4050 AS DOUBLE) AS longitude, CASE "mrid" WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:temperature-2m-c' THEN 'Temperature (°C)' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:wind-speed-10m-kmh' THEN 'Wind speed (km/h)' WHEN 'urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:wind-direction-10m-degrees' THEN 'Wind direction (°)' END AS metric, LATEST_BY("double_value", "__time") AS "value", MAX("__time") AS observed_at FROM "live_measurements" WHERE "mrid" IN ('urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:temperature-2m-c','urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:wind-speed-10m-kmh','urn:wama:poc:weather:berlin:wind-direction-10m-degrees') AND "__time" BETWEEN MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__from}) AND MILLIS_TO_TIMESTAMP(${__to}) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
